meta.title: Ondra Weather
meta.description: Weather that only speaks when it has explicit coordinates. With a latitude,longitude pair it asks Open-Meteo for current conditions plus today's high, low and precipitation chance, and keeps the answer in memory for ten minutes. A missing or malformed coordinate, a timeout, or a changed payload yields a reason code instead of a guessed forecast. Nothing is written to disk, no tool is registered, and no message is sent into a conversation.
